scripts.preinstall: [ "$NODE_ENV" = 'production' ] && echo '⚠️  NODE_ENV=production — devDependencies will be skipped. Run: unset NODE_ENV' >&2 || true
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.prebuild:be: npm run generate:entries -w @app/default-setup && npm run compile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:fe && npm run typecheck:be && npm run typecheck:sdk && npm run typecheck:host && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:pack && echo '✅ All type checks passed!'
scripts.typecheck:fe: npm run type-check --workspace @app/renderer && echo '✅ Frontend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:be: cd packages/api && npx tsc -p . --noEmit && echo '✅ Backend type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/sdk && echo '✅ SDK type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:host: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/host && echo '✅ Host type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:ui: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/ui && echo '✅ UI type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run typecheck --workspace @abuddy/cli --workspace @abuddy/testing && echo '✅ CLI + testing type check passed'
scripts.typecheck:pack: npm run typecheck --workspace @app/default-setup && echo '✅ Default-setup pack type check passed'
scripts.packages:check: publint --strict packages/abuddy-sdk && publint --strict packages/abuddy-ui && publint --strict packages/abuddy-cli/dist/package && publint --strict packages/abuddy-testing/dist/package && npm run attw -w @abuddy/sdk -w @abuddy/ui && attw --pack packages/abuddy-testing/dist/package --profile esm-only
